standard_prerequisites.name: Perfect modules of tor dimension at most one and their two-term locally free presentations
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, flat.tex, the material on perfect modules and tor dimension preceding this lemma (the statement uses tor dimension <= 1 and perfectness without recalling them)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that a perfect module of tor dimension <= 1 admits locally a two-term presentation by finite free modules, which is the presentation used at proof lines 13234-13237.

standard_prerequisites.name: The affine blowup algebra A[I/a] and its relation to the localization A_a
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Divisors, Section on blowing up (Stacks tags 0804-0806 region), specifically the definition of the affine blowup algebra as a subring of A_a
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that A[I/a] is a subring of A_a so that the localization argument at proof lines 13239-13242 applies; the blowup itself is only the ambient construction, not a counted step.

core_obligations: Reduce to the affine case X = Spec(A) with F corresponding to a finitely presented A-module M that admits a presentation 0 -> A^{oplus m} -> A^{oplus n} -> M -> 0 (proof lines 13233-13237).

For an ideal I in A and an element a in I, use that the affine blowup algebra A[I/a] is a subring of A_a and that localization is exact, so the injectivity of A_a^{oplus m} -> A_a^{oplus n} descends to injectivity of A[I/a]^{oplus m} -> A[I/a]^{oplus n}, which simultaneously shows that the pullback needs no higher derived terms and that the resulting module still has a two-term free presentation (proof lines 13238-13242).
proof_roadmap: Pass to the affine local picture and take the two-term presentation of M (proof lines 13233-13237).
Embed the affine blowup algebra into the localization, use exactness of localization, and read off both conclusions (proof lines 13238-13242).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts two things about a perfect O_X-module F of tor dimension <= 1 and an arbitrary blowup b : X' -> X: that the derived pullback Lb^*F coincides with the ordinary pullback b^*F, and that b^*F is again perfect of tor dimension <= 1 (statement lines 13223-13230). The proof is short but it is a genuine reduction rather than a citation: it passes to X = Spec(A), takes a two-term presentation 0 -> A^m -> A^n -> M -> 0 of the module M attached to F, recalls that the affine blowup algebra A[I/a] is a subring of the localization A_a, and then uses exactness of localization to transfer the injectivity of A_a^m -> A_a^n down to A[I/a]^m -> A[I/a]^n (proof lines 13233-13242). Locating the argument in the subring A[I/a] rather than in A_a, and noticing that the two-term presentation is what makes both assertions fall out at once, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
